snippet.title: Grand Theft Auto VI - Features Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/EP1004-PPSA01547_00-GTAVISTANDARD001

Grand Theft Auto VI for PS5 includes high fidelity haptic feedback fully integrated across the game on DualSense controllers and adjustable via accessibility settings, improved spatial audio rendering so all in-game sounds take full advantage of Tempest 3D Audio, and improved load times, making Grand Theft Auto VI play best on PlayStation 5 consoles. Watch the PlayStation®5 Features Trailer to see more.

Grand Theft Auto VI launches November 19th, 2026. Pre-load now
